heading: Ignition Timing
text:
EM-13
ENGINE MECHANICAL - IGNITION TIM!NG
IGNITION TIMING
INSPECTION
1. WARM UP ENGINE
Allow the engine to warm up to normal operating temperature.
2. CONNECT TOYOTA HAND-HELD TESTER OR 08D11
SCAN TOOL
(a) Connect the TOYOTA hand-held teĀter or O8DI1 scan
tool to the DLC3.
(b) Please refer to the TOYOTA hand-held tester or O8D!1
scan tool operator's for further details.
3. CONNECT TIMING LIGHT TO ENGINE
4. INSPECT IGNITION TIMING.----- ---- Using a timing light, check the ignition timing. - -&·/,,;
Ignition timing:
1ZZ-FE:
10-18 Q BTDC@ Idle
2ZZ-GE:
8 -12 Q BTDC@ idle
(Transmission In neutral position)
HINT:
After engine rpm is kept at 1,000 - 1,300 rpm for 5 seconds,
check that it retuÿns to idle speed.
5. DISCONNECT TIMING LIGHT FROM ENGINE
6. DISCONNECT TOYOTA HAND-HELD TESTER OR
OBDII SCAN TOOL
